# Security / Безопасность

Found a security issue? Please don't open a public issue — use **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/sunic007/tvinstaller/security/advisories/new)** (private).

Нашли уязвимость? Не пишите в открытый issue — сообщите приватно через **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/sunic007/tvinstaller/security/advisories/new)**.
